name: Destroy Number
author: Addicting Games
description: Destroy Number is a free math puzzle game. This week we are all about zeroing out the tiles. there are too many numbers, and their values are too high, we have to stop them, we have to decrease their value and then have them zero out. In this game, you will be tasked with zeroing out all of the values onscreen by ramming the numbers into each other until there are no more numbers. This is like math class but actually a lot more fun. It is applied mathematics or at least applied addition. You need to add numberss together until you get at least two that are the same and then smash those together so they zero each other out. Of course, we realize that this all sounds simple but it absolutely isn't, it is actually extremely hard. There are people who started playing this game five years ago and they're still playing it and they've actually been playing it the whole and they're also really smart people it is not like they're dumb or something. So, if you think you're better than this game, better than us, or better than our game-testers then we dare you to actually play it and prove it to us.
